3. Solar power has environmental benefits, but it cannot fully replace 
**fossil fuels**. 
(Use: While…) 
4. Geothermal plants are efficient. They cannot be built everywhere. 
(Use: Despite…) 
5. Wind energy is sustainable, and many governments encourage its 
use. 
(Use: As a result…) 
IELTS Essay Topic 
"Some people believe that investment in alternative energy sources is 
the most effective way to address environmental problems. To what 
extent do you agree or disagree?"
